facts.claim: The Rdjah of Coorg has recovered his hereditary principality from Tippu Sultan.
facts.quote: The Rdjah of Coorg has himself recovered his here- ditary principality from Tippu Sultan.

facts.claim: The Rdjah freely opened his country to the Bombay forces and supplied them with grain, cattle, etc.
facts.quote: The Rdjah freely opened his country to the Bombay forces, which marched from Tellicherry to Mysore, and was most zealous in providing the Company's troops with every thing he could procure for them in Coorg and Mysore.

facts.claim: Lord Cornwallis wanted to place the Rdjah of Coorg under the special protection of the Company after the treaty at Seringapatam.
facts.quote: In March last, when the treaty was concluded at Seringapatam, Lord Cornwallis, in order to free the Rdjah of Coorg entirely from the power of Tippu, desired to take him under the special protection of the Company.
